title: Wine Fridge Door-Open Duration
app: Meater probes, Anova Precision Cooker sessions, Instant Pot logs, wine-fridge sensors, ESPHome kitchen sensors, and pantry inventory feeds via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=kitchen:appliance appliance_type=wine_fridge event=door
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(open_duration_min) as open_duration_min by appliance _time
| where open_duration_min>15
| sort - open_duration_min
description: Uses Wine-fridge door events telemetry to monitor how long the door stayed open each day in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for usage patterns that threaten temperature stability, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Wine-fridge door events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Daily table of wine-fridge door-open minutes.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds how long the door stayed open each day so you can spot usage patterns that threaten temperature stability before it becomes annoying.
